name: Time Blocking: Novice to Pro
instructions: Plan your week's blocks in one sitting (Sunday evening or Monday morning) rather than re-deciding every single day.
Color-code blocks by category (deep work, admin, personal) so your week's balance is visible at a glance.
Protect your most important blocks the way you would protect a meeting with someone else -- treat them as non-negotiable.
Watch today's video to take your time blocking from beginner to advanced.
